contradictions.what: Rep says we were the favourite and Ben told his team to plan integration, but Ben was not the decider and Halima chose the competitor.
Rep thought the load test had won it, yet Halima's only response was 'good' and she asked for an on-sale plan.
Rep answered Halima's 'who' question with support plans, tiers and response times; the customer never said 'support'.
Rep says we were the better platform, but the deal was lost on something the customer weighed above platform strength.
